home_meta_description: Handmade ceramics from Brno - angels, animals, figures and other pieces made with love.
hero_text: Angels, animals, figures and other pieces for your home. I make each piece by hand in my small studio in Brno - for joy, as a gift, and for the pleasure of the soul.
value_handmade_text: I make every piece by hand in my studio in Brno. No mass production.
value_motifs_text: Angels, animals and figures from my own designs.
value_original_text: Thanks to the handwork, each piece is unique. No two are the same.
products_meta_description: Browse the handmade ceramics categories - angels, animals, figures and decor.
products_intro: Pick a category and browse every piece that belongs to it.
category_empty: There is nothing in this category yet.
category_angels_desc: Ceramic angels for joy or as a gift.
category_animals_desc: Birds, cats, fish and other little animals.
category_figures_desc: Acorn folk and other figures with their own character.
category_decor_desc: Small decorative pieces for the home.
product_desc_angel: A ceramic guardian angel - a small gift for joy and a little luck around the home. Each piece is one of a kind.
product_desc_bird: A small ceramic bird to brighten up a shelf or a windowsill.
product_desc_cat: A ceramic cat with its own expression. A perfect gift for cat lovers.
product_desc_fish: A ceramic fish in soft tones. Lovely as decor or as a gift.
product_desc_dubanek: A ceramic acorn folk - a cute little figure inspired by autumn nature.
product_desc_guy: A ceramic little guy with his own character. Each one is different and unique.
product_desc_leaf: A ceramic leaf - a small decoration for the wall, a shelf, or as a dish for trinkets.
product_care_default: Handmade ceramics. We recommend hand washing in lukewarm water and handling with care - this is a decorative piece.
product_detail_shipping_text: We ship within 3-5 business days. Personal pickup in Brno by arrangement.
product_instances_intro: Every piece is one of a kind. Pick the one for you.
about_text: I have been working with ceramics for many years, and what I enjoy most is making decorative pieces. I am fascinated by how a thing with its own character emerges from a lump of clay. I make each piece by hand in my studio in Brno.
footer_copy: © {year} Lada Bartoníková · Made with love in Brno
